entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: The 355-aa query sequence has 49.1–54.5% identity and 94.1–94.4% query coverage to reviewed reference enzymes assigned EC 1.2.1.11.
Reference annotations describe NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of 4-phospho-L-aspartate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde.

entities.name: Aspartate semialdehyde synthesis
observations: Reference reaction (Rhea RHEA:24284): 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H+ → L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP+; the reported Rhea direction is reversible/unspecified.

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: Homolog annotations place the enzyme in the aspartate-derived pathways leading to lysine, methionine, and threonine.
